title: Walk to Nissan · 2BR · TV's "Nashville" House
description:
The actual home from ABC/CMT's hit TV series 'Nashville' — Deacon Claybourne's house, now a 2BR / 2BA East Nashville rental that sleeps 4 (king + queen). Stone fireplace, chef's kitchen with Viking cooktop, pellet ice-maker, wine fridge, and a private fenced backyard with fire pit. Show memorabilia throughout. Walk to Nissan Stadium (0.9 mi) for Titans games and CMA Fest. Walk to Five Points dining. Free street parking. Best for Titans game weekends, couples weekends, CMA Fest, anniversary trips

The space
Welcome to Deacon's House, brought to you by Music City Magnolia. A Nashville vacation rental in Edgefield (East Nashville) — 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, sleeps 4. Best for Titans games, couples weekends, CMA Fest.

WHAT MAKES IT SPECIAL
• The actual home from ABC/CMT's hit TV series 'Nashville' (Deacon Claybourne's house)
• Walkable to Nissan Stadium (0.9 mi) — Titans games and CMA Fest
• 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, sleeps 4 (king + queen)
• Chef's kitchen with Viking cooktop and pellet ice-maker
• Five Points East Nashville dining in walking distance

LAYOUT
2 bedrooms, 2 baths. Two-story home; bedrooms upstairs, stairs required.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The owner is not present during rentals; any modification to that arrangement would be communicated to guests in advance.

PARKING & PETS
Parking: Free street parking on property. Not pet friendly.

IMPORTANT TO NOTE
Check-in: 3:00 PM via contactless door code. Door code and arrival instructions are sent at 11:00 AM on arrival day. Check-out: 11:00 AM. Rental Agreement must be e-signed before your door code activates. Properties are typically booked back-to-back; early check-in and late check-out cannot be accommodated. No luggage drop-off. Exterior security cameras are in place for your safety. Locked owner/supply closets are off-limits. Quiet hours 10 PM – 7 AM (Nashville ordinance).

Guest access
Guests have full access to all 2 bedrooms, the full kitchen and living space, fenced outdoor space. Parking: Free street parking on property. Not pet friendly. The owner is not present during rentals; any modification to that arrangement would be communicated to guests in advance. Locked owner/supply closets are off-limits. Exterior security cameras are in place for your safety.

Other things to note
Come stay in the place Deacon Claybourne (Charles “Chip” Esten) called home in the hit TV Series, "Nashville'! Located in historic Edgefield, an East Nashville neighborhood, just 0.9 mi from Titans' Stadium and 1.8 mi from the action on Broadway. Bike or walk to Downtown--Nashville B-Cycle has a rental kiosk just a few blocks away, and Eastside Cycles is available nearby for rentals, sales, routes, and repairs on your bikes.
